method_signature: public TransactionData execute(PlatformContext context, TransactionData data)

request_data_extractions.purpose: Extract the top three design configuration keys from the request payload to begin fallback validation filtering.
Capture the internal record unique identifier token to map into the outbound response metadata.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: int currentYear = java.util.Calendar.getInstance().get(java.util.Calendar.YEAR); boolean anyDecadeHistory = false; for(String cfg : top_three_configurations) { int count = context.executeVolumeQuery("cu_esn_bom_option_config_notes", "byYearCutoff", cfg, currentYear - 10); if(count > 0) { anyDecadeHistory = true; } } if(!anyDecadeHistory) { context.triggerExternalService("WindchillService", data); return data; }
workflow_steps.purpose: Confirm production viability across a trailing 10-year bracket for all three configurations, instantly throwing an external service hook if all profiles return zero records.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: String finalConfig = null; int highestRecentCount = -1; for(String cfg : top_three_configurations) { int recent = context.executeHorizonQuery("cu_esn_bom_option_config_notes", "recentHorizon", cfg, currentYear - 5); int older = context.executeHorizonQuery("cu_esn_bom_option_config_notes", "olderHorizon", cfg, currentYear - 10, currentYear - 5); if(recent > older) { if(recent > highestRecentCount) { highestRecentCount = recent; finalConfig = cfg; } } } if(finalConfig == null) { context.triggerExternalService("WindchillService", data); return data; }
workflow_steps.purpose: Analyze production deltas across all candidates between a 5-year and 10-year horizon, selecting the configuration with the highest recent expansion volume.

workflow_steps.code_snippet: com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String, Object> cfgParams = com.google.common.collect.ArrayListMultimap.create(); cfgParams.put("code", finalConfig); context.streamDataFromDB("configuration", "bySelectedConfigCode", cfgParams, record -> { resolvedSpecs.putAll(record); });
workflow_steps.purpose: Resolve six master catalog engineering fields using the dynamically verified high-performing configuration token code.

conditional_routing.condition: at least one candidate passes the growth trajectory checks and registers the absolute highest volume score inside the recent 5-year block

scenarios.description: Verifies successful part master updates when multiple configurations show positive growth vectors, prioritizing the absolute highest volume option.
Verifies that the system completely skips analysis and fires a windchill service synchronization event if all 3 configurations lack a decade of build records.
Verifies that execution drops out to windchill service handlers if all configurations fail the strict horizon growth requirement.
